# Sublime UX
> High-stakes digital architecture and institutional indexing for non-profits, foundations, and public-private partnerships. Specializing in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Information Gain strategies.

## Core Frameworks
- [V2V Framework](https://www.sublimeux.com/services/V2VFramework): A proprietary three-phase digital architecture system (Visibility, Trust, Velocity) for mission acceleration and institutional authority.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.sublimeux.com/services/V2VFramework): Advanced strategies for ensuring organizational missions are correctly synthesized and cited by AI agents like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
- [Information Gain Strategy](https://www.sublimeux.com/services/V2VFramework): Methodology for engineering unique, non-derivative content metrics that AI models prioritize for "original data" citations.

## Key Services
- [Small Business SEO & AEO](https://www.sublimeux.com/services/small-business-seo-aeo): Modern search and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for local craftsmen, contractors, and regional firms. Google Map 3-Pack grounding, entity schema fortification, and AI citation readiness to move from invisible to indispensable.
- [High-Stakes Audit](https://www.sublimeux.com/services/HighStakesAudit): Comprehensive technical assessment of digital infrastructure, focusing on Performance, Security, and ADA Compliance.
- [Content Blueprint](https://www.sublimeux.com/services/ContentBlueprint): Strategic alignment of institutional goals with conversion-oriented digital architecture.
- [Institutional Alignment](https://www.sublimeux.com/#contact-us): Stakeholder workshops designed to bridge the gap between policy objectives and digital execution.
